Frequently Asked Questions

Marvin Bagley III is 27 years old.

Marvin Bagley III was born in Tempe, Arizona.

Marvin Bagley III was born on March 14, 1999.

How tall is Marvin Bagley III?

Marvin Bagley III is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much does Marvin Bagley III weigh?

Marvin Bagley III weighs 235 lbs (106 kg).

Is Marvin Bagley III in the Hall of Fame?

Marvin Bagley III is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Marvin Bagley III drafted?

Marvin Bagley III was drafted by Sacramento Kings, 1st round (2nd pick, 2nd overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Marvin Bagley III play?

Power Forward and Center.

What is Marvin Bagley III's net worth?

Marvin Bagley III has made at least $75,933,748 playing professional basketball.

How much does Marvin Bagley III make?

Marvin Bagley III made $12,500,000 in 2023.

How many rings does Marvin Bagley III have?

Marvin Bagley III has won 0 championships.

What is Marvin Bagley III's Instagram account?

Marvin Bagley III is on Instagram at mb3five.

What schools did Marvin Bagley III attend?
